Artifacts & Councilors for Legendary Tokens From August onward, Marco will feature only new Councilors & Mythical Artifacts.

title: 11th Anniversary
parsed_names: versions of past Legendary Artifacts over the next couple of months
mythical_sentences: This year, we’ll be introducing new Legendary & Mythical Artifacts, April will include a returning in-game community challenge, and we’ll give an early look at what you can expect in May.
5 update! New Legendary & Mythical Artifacts! You can look forward to brand new Legendary Artifacts that highlight DomiNations' history.
Keep an eye out in Week Aheads and our Socials for the latest drops! We’ll also introduce new Mythical versions of past Legendary Artifacts over the next couple of months.
One of the first was the Mythical Elephant Archer Quiver, available now from Marco.
